title: ObservabilityEvent
description: Schema for a single observability event written to an events.jsonl file. Each line in the file is a valid JSON object conforming to this schema.

timestamp.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of when the event occurred (e.g., 2026-02-17T14:32:00Z).

agent.description: Identifier of the agent that produced this event (e.g., 'coding-agent', 'test-agent', 'gate-agent', 'spec-agent').

story_id.description: Story identifier that this event belongs to (e.g., 'STORY-042'). Must match the story ID across all artifacts for this pipeline run.

event_type.description: Discriminator field. Determines which additional properties are required.

oneOf.title: AgentStart
oneOf.description: Emitted once when an agent begins processing a story. Must be the first event an agent writes.

input_refs.description: File paths or artifact identifiers that this agent received as input (e.g., spec file path, implementation report path).

oneOf.title: Decision
oneOf.description: Emitted when an agent makes a significant choice that affects outputs — e.g., classifying a module, selecting an implementation pattern, or choosing to skip a check.

decision.description: A concise statement of the decision made (e.g., 'Classified AuthModule as KMP candidate').

rationale.description: The reasoning behind the decision, referencing specific evidence from input artifacts where possible.

confidence.description: The agent's confidence in this decision. Low confidence should trigger a question event or human review flag.

input_refs.description: Optional. File paths or artifact identifiers that informed this decision.

oneOf.title: ArtifactWrite
oneOf.description: Emitted each time an agent writes or overwrites an artifact (report file, CSV, JSON, etc.).

output_ref.description: File path of the artifact written (e.g., 'methodology/reports/STORY-042-implementation-report.md').

input_refs.description: File paths or artifact identifiers that were read to produce this artifact.

oneOf.title: ArtifactRead
oneOf.description: Emitted each time an agent reads an artifact that was produced by another agent or external system.

input_ref.description: File path or artifact identifier of the artifact read.

purpose.description: A brief statement of why this artifact was read (e.g., 'Reading implementation report to verify spec coverage before running tests').

oneOf.title: Question
oneOf.description: Emitted when an agent encounters ambiguity it cannot resolve autonomously. Blocking questions halt the pipeline until answered. Non-blocking questions are logged for human review but do not halt the pipeline.

question.description: The specific question the agent needs answered, stated precisely enough for a human or another agent to respond unambiguously.

blocking.description: True if the pipeline cannot proceed without an answer. False if the agent can proceed with a documented assumption and log the question for later review.

context.description: Optional. Background information that helps the reviewer understand why the question arose.

oneOf.title: GateCheck
oneOf.description: Emitted once per check in the Quality Gate Agent's Checks table. Eight gate_check events are expected per gate run, one for each required check.

check_name.description: The name of the check as it appears in the gate report Checks table (e.g., 'spec_completeness', 'test_coverage', 'traceability').

result.description: The outcome of this individual check.

details.description: Optional. Explanation of the result — required when result is FAIL, optional when PASS.

oneOf.title: GateVerdict
oneOf.description: Emitted once by the Quality Gate Agent after all gate_check events have been emitted. Must be the final event in the gate agent's run for a story.

verdict.description: The overall gate verdict. Must match the Verdict field in the gate report document.

failing_checks.description: Optional. List of check names that resulted in FAIL. Required when verdict is GATE_FAIL; omit or set to empty array when verdict is GATE_PASS or GATE_REVIEW_NEEDED.

oneOf.title: HumanAction
oneOf.description: Emitted by the orchestration system when a human reviewer takes an action on a story (approve, reject, waive). This event is written by the system on behalf of the human, not by the human directly.

reviewer.description: Identity of the human reviewer (name, username, or role — e.g., 'tech-lead', 'jsmith').

rationale.description: Optional. The reviewer's stated reason for the action. Required when action is 'rejected' or 'waived-*'.
